result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and a large triangular refuge island, providing some protection for pedestrians. However, the very wide crossing distance and the presence of a slip lane for right-turning vehicles create significant exposure and potential for high-speed conflicts.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration across multiple lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway crossing in the foreground and center.

hazards.name: Slip Lane
hazards.description: The channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning across a pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the triangular island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners limit sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbsides adjacent to the crosswalk entrances.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility at the corners.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow turning vehicles and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide intersection geometry and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The corners of the intersection are wide, which can encourage vehicles to make turns at higher speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge or physical protection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide four-lane commercial corridor with sidewalks and overhead traffic signals. The environment is characterized by a long unprotected crossing distance and a lack of physical traffic calming or pedestrian refuge, which increases risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes and lack of vertical or horizontal deflection encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median at the crossing to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, but the wide roadway creates significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks pedestrian refuge islands and visible pedestrian-specific signaling.
